_comment: Source of truth for every trinket. Each set holds 12 items in position order: 1-6 common, 7-9 rare, 10-11 epic, 12 legendary (the chase piece). Each item is [name, placeholder emoji, one-line art subject]. Edit here, then run: node generate-trinkets.mjs

a floppy-eared beagle puppy with a little red knitted collar
